title: Run a live webinar
blurb: Set up registration, reminders and a watch page for a live online event.

steps.title: Open Sites
steps.body: Build a short sign-up form in **Forms** first. Then click **Sites** in the left menu.

steps.title: Create the webinar
steps.body: Click **New Webinar Funnel** and choose **Live Webinar**.

steps.title: Name, date and time
steps.body: Enter the webinar name, pick the time zone (Pacific/Auckland) and set the date and start time.

steps.title: Pick the sign-up form
steps.body: Choose the form people fill in to register. Name and email is enough.

steps.title: Add the live link
steps.body: Paste your Zoom or YouTube Live link. Test that it opens before the day.

steps.title: Choose a template
steps.body: Pick a template. Your registration, confirmation, watch and replay pages are created for you to edit.

steps.title: Check the reminders
steps.body: Each webinar comes with a reminder automation. Open it from the three-dot menu and adjust the wording and timing.
steps.tip: Reminders a day before, an hour before and 10 minutes before work well.
